name: requirement-checks
description: Check whether a produced artifact satisfies explicit requirements.
instructions: Judge only against the listed requirements. A model check complements deterministic validation; it does not replace it.

passes.instructions: Does the artifact satisfy every listed requirement?

unmet_has_title.instructions: Is the 'has_title' requirement unsatisfied? The artifact must open with a title heading.

unmet_has_summary.instructions: Is the 'has_summary' requirement unsatisfied? The artifact must contain a summary.

unmet_cites_sources.instructions: Is the 'cites_sources' requirement unsatisfied? Claims must cite a source.

unmet_under_word_limit.instructions: Is the 'under_word_limit' requirement unsatisfied? The artifact must be at most 200 words.

review_depth.instructions: How much additional human review does this artifact need?
levels: Spot check: skim the flagged sections
Full review: a person must read it end to end
